# David Friedman

> Lead web designer and Webflow and WordPress developer at 97 Switch, a Chicago digital agency. Based in Tampa, Florida. Designs, builds and maintains marketing and booking websites for hospitality, real estate, finance and technology brands, and builds AI-assisted workflows with Claude Code.

## Pages

- [Home](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/): about, approach, roles, experience, FAQ
- [Projects](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects): ten web design case studies
- [Hotel EMC2](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/hotel-emc2): Booking-first website for an art-and-science boutique hotel in Streeterville, Chicago.
- [ROOF on theWit](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/roof-on-thewit): An events-driven site for a rooftop bar 27 stories above Chicago's Loop.
- [Smash Virtual](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/smash-virtual): A cinematic marketing site for Chicago's first virtual production studio.
- [HydraVault](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/hydravault): A leasing site that leads with the specs for a purpose-built AI data center under construction in Chicago.
- [Goodman Campaigns](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/goodman-campaigns): A bold, results-first website for a digital fundraising agency that helps downballot Democrats raise more.
- [Great Society Strategies](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/great-society-strategies): A site with archival character for a political consulting firm, organized around services, case studies and insights.
- [SideGigster](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/sidegigster): A new brand and a conversion-focused site for a gig-economy affiliate program.
- [GSD Decisions](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/ecd-company): A geometric, fast Webflow rebuild for a Chicago real estate firm with a $1B+ portfolio.
- [CompTIA A+](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/comptia-a-plus): A mobile-first landing page with custom motion graphics for the entry-level IT certification.
- [CompTIA ChannelCon](https://davidbenjaminfriedman.com/projects/comptia-channelcon): A Y2K-inspired design system that carried one theme across three global conferences.

## Roles a fit for

- Lead or senior web designer: Has led web design at two agencies, running a team, owning projects from brief to launch and managing the client relationship.
- Webflow or WordPress developer: Clean class structure, CMS builds, interactions, launch QA and client training, on whichever platform fits the team.
- UX and UI designer for marketing sites: Figma design systems, wireframes and conversion-focused page structure for hospitality, real estate, finance and technology brands.
- Design technologist: Claude Code for prototyping, documentation and automation, plus AI workflow architecture a team can maintain.

## FAQ

**Who is David Friedman?**
David Friedman is the Lead Web Designer at 97 Switch, a Chicago digital agency. He is based in Tampa, Florida, and designs, builds and maintains Webflow and WordPress websites for clients across the U.S.

**What does David design and build?**
Marketing, booking and lead-generation websites. His work covers discovery, UX and information architecture, Figma design systems, Webflow or WordPress builds with a CMS, QA, SEO set-up, launch and post-launch care.

**Does David work in Webflow or WordPress?**
Both. He picks the platform that suits the client's team and goals, with clean class structure, CMS where content changes often, and training so clients can edit their own sites.

**Which industries has David worked in?**
Hospitality, real estate, technology and IT, professional development, finance, food and beverage, and political consulting. Case studies include Hotel EMC2, ROOF on theWit, Smash Virtual, GSD Decisions and CompTIA.

**Does David use AI in his work?**
Yes. He uses Claude Code to prototype, document and automate, and designs AI workflows and the architecture behind them, so teams can trust and maintain what is built.

**What roles is David a fit for?**
Lead or senior web designer, Webflow or WordPress developer, UX and UI designer for marketing sites, and design technologist roles that mix design, build and AI-assisted workflows.

**How can I contact David?**
Message David on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/david-b-friedman. He is open to full-time roles and select projects.
